certificate: URT cut-and-project acceptance-window and streaming no-go

conditional_discrete_repairs.remaining_limit: Even these two choices do not evade the uniform-streaming no-go; they define a canonical partial neighbour graph, not twelve edges available at every site.

twelve_displacement_orbit.C5_fixed_lattice: For a representative C5, every fixed integral vector is z=(a,b,a,b,b,a) and ||z||^2=5[a^2+(a-b)^2].
twelve_displacement_orbit.Hodge_split: The two orbits have Hodge signatures +/-10 and swap the squared physical/internal lengths (5+2sqrt(5))/2 and (5-2sqrt(5))/2.
twelve_displacement_orbit.consequence: This selects one 12-vector icosahedral orbit discretely.
twelve_displacement_orbit.extra_principle: After choosing the physical Hodge sector, select the minimum-norm C5-fixed orbit with the smaller internal displacement (equivalently the larger acceptance overlap for a ball window).
twelve_displacement_orbit.minimum: The minimum nonzero norm is 5, with four vectors forming two antipodal pairs per C5.  Across six C5 subgroups these are two A5 orbits of 12.
twelve_displacement_orbit.status: C: a viable locality selector, not yet a derived axiom

window.consequence: The isoperimetric equality selects a ball up to translation; central reversal fixes its centre.  The radius remains free unless density/window volume is separately fixed.
window.extra_principle: At fixed window volume, minimize Euclidean boundary area.
window.status: C: target-blind but not derived by URT

continuous_fixed_volume_window_family.icosahedral_harmonic: h6(u)=sum_{v in the 12-point icosahedron}(u dot v)^6-12/7
continuous_fixed_volume_window_family.inequivalence: h6 is nonconstant, so W_epsilon and W_0 have nonempty symmetric difference for epsilon!=0.  Density of pi_-(Lambda^2 A4) makes the corresponding model sets different.
continuous_fixed_volume_window_family.properties: For every sufficiently small real epsilon these windows are compact, smooth, centrally symmetric and A5-invariant; small C2 perturbations of the ball can also be kept strictly convex.
continuous_fixed_volume_window_family.radial_windows: W_epsilon={r u: 0<=r<=R C_epsilon[1+epsilon h6(u)]}, with C_epsilon chosen so Vol(W_epsilon) is fixed
continuous_fixed_volume_window_family.theorem: Metric, Hodge conjugation, A5, reversal, lattice covolume and even fixed window volume do not select an acceptance window.
continuous_fixed_volume_window_family.zero_mean: The spherical average of (u dot v)^6 is 1/7 for each unit v, so the average of h6 is zero.

shortest_full_lattice_shell.consequence: Minimum six-dimensional lattice norm selects 20 directions, not the Cathedral 12-direction shell.

global_uniform_streaming_no_go.assumption: A fixed nonzero l in Lambda^2 A4 and both translations +/-pi_+(l) map every point of Lambda(W) back into Lambda(W).
global_uniform_streaming_no_go.consequence: A compact-window quasicrystal permits only site-dependent partial edges for any nonzero displacement; it cannot realize a uniform reversible lattice-Boltzmann stream on every site.
global_uniform_streaming_no_go.proof: Internal projections of selected lattice points are dense in W. The assumption gives W+pi_-(l) subset W and W-pi_-(l) subset W, hence W+pi_-(l)=W.  A nonempty compact set cannot be invariant under a nonzero translation.  Injectivity of pi_- gives l=0, a contradiction.

model_set.definition: Lambda(W)={pi_+(z): z in Lambda^2 A4, pi_-(z) in W}, with compact regular W subset E_-
model_set.regular_window: W is the closure of its nonempty interior and has boundary of three-dimensional measure zero

verdict.advance: The weakest explicit discrete repair found is fixed-volume isoperimetry plus minimum internal displacement in the shortest C5-fixed shell.  It remains a new locality axiom and yields only a site-dependent quasicrystal graph.
